summary: Iter2 testing: Backend 43/43 pytest tests pass (25 regression + 18 new for settings, areas, force-logout, seller/customer settings, favorites, kind filters, order validation, sides subtotal, maintenance mode). Frontend smoke: header (logo, brand 'JubaSquare BY L.T.G ENTERPRISE', Wholesale link), footer logo, /login 3 demo buttons + redirects, /wholesale (6 cards, Verified Supplier badges, min-qty + bulk price), /marketplace (retail-only, 18 products), /favorites (renders + empty state), /cart (phone required asterisk + toast 'Phone number is required to place an order' blocks API call), /settings as admin (Currency / Shop Control / Verification / Modules / Areas cards visible, 1 USD = X SSP rate field, all toggles working). Dark-mode for customer also visible after API toggle. Cart persistence (iter1 bug) is FIXED via lazy useState.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1176 lines — should be split into routers (auth, admin, shops, products, restaurants, orders, favorites, settings, seeding) for maintainability before next iteration.

Login attempt limit not actively tested in pytest because it would lock out demo accounts for 15min for parallel runs; it is implemented and verified by code review (uses ip:email key, 15-min window). Consider exposing an admin endpoint to clear login_attempts records for test cleanup.
place_order does not validate item_id existence in DB nor recompute prices server-side — accepts client-supplied price_usd. Acceptable for demo; in production trust DB prices to prevent tampering.
DELETE /api/admin/areas/{area} silently succeeds even if area doesn't exist — fine but consider 404 for clarity.
force-logout-all increments token_version globally for ALL users (admin sessions also invalidated). Tests confirm intended behavior; just a documentation note for E1.

Both @app.on_event('startup') and CORSMiddleware allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — modern browsers will reject this combination on prod (must use explicit origins with credentials). Works in preview because cookies aren't strictly required (Bearer fallback).
seed_data_creation: None — relied on auto-seeded 9 retail + 3 wholesale + 4 restaurants. Each test cleans up its own TEST_-prefixed shops/areas/favorites and reverts admin settings (auto_approve_shops, maintenance_mode, auto_hide_out_of_stock).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files now: backend_test.py (regression, 25) + test_iter2_features.py (new, 18). The TestZForceLogout class is intentionally last because it bumps token_version and invalidates all earlier-issued tokens. If you add tests after it, fetch fresh tokens. Frontend data-testids verified: login-{role}-button, wholesale-card-*, add-to-cart-*, place-order-btn, cart-phone-input. Heart-icon testid prefix on product cards may not be 'fav-product-' (selector check returned False) — but heart icons render visually in marketplace; if writing fav-toggle test, inspect actual data-testid first.
